metadata.description: AI capabilities for the Casper Network: a skill that answers Casper questions from current, cited sources, and ready-made connections to Casper MCP servers.

plugins.name: casper
plugins.description: The casper skill: where current Casper documentation lives, what changed since the 2.0 docs, casper-client 5.x commands, and which MCP server answers what.

plugins.name: cspr-trade
plugins.description: Connects the public CSPR.trade MCP server by MAKE: Casper DEX market data, quotes and non-custodial swap building. No key needed.

plugins.name: cspr-cloud
plugins.description: Connects the hosted CSPR.cloud MCP servers by MAKE for Casper mainnet and testnet data. Needs CSPR_CLOUD_API_KEY set in your environment.

plugins.name: casperai
plugins.description: Connects CasperAI's MCP server: cited answers about Casper (paid per call) and casper-client command building (free). Needs CASPERAI_API_KEY set in your environment.

plugins.name: odra-plugin
plugins.description: Odra's own plugin for writing, testing and deploying Odra smart contracts, installed from odradev/odradev-plugins.
